combine_v2_agent_role_contract_index.description: Index of all Combine V2 agent role contracts. Each contract defines full professional job instructions: role, mission, authority, responsibilities, allowed/forbidden actions, inputs, outputs, acceptance/rejection criteria, handoff rules, proof requirements, and JSON output schema.

agents.summary: Pipeline Director and State Machine Controller. Owns state machine, routes tasks, blocks forbidden transitions, detects contradictions.
Creative Intent Extraction and Brief Specification Officer. Extracts operator intent, defines shot/style/subject intent, manages reference hierarchy.
Generation Recipe and Workflow Plan Engineer. Builds generation recipe, selects prompt/model/resolution/quality strategy, injects guardrails.
Authorized Generation Execution and Output Collection Officer. Executes one authorized generation, captures proof, hands off manifest.
File Integrity and Asset Manifest Verification Officer. Validates file integrity, SHA256, dimensions, detects stubs/corruption.
Independent Visual Quality Assurance and Rejection Authority. Independent blocking authority, technical PASS != visual PASS, requires operator visual review.
Corrective Retry Strategy and Implementation Planner. Creates corrective plans from defect taxonomy, prevents blind retry, requires operator authorization.
Assembly, Render, and Downstream Pipeline Security Gate. Blocks downstream while production_accepted=false, prevents silent substitution.
Pipeline Integrity, Artifact Freeze, and Contradiction Auditor. Audits tests, artifacts, state, contradictions, forbidden actions. Can reject even if tests pass.
